projects.title: Automated Battle Management Aid (ABMA)
projects.description:
A tool that recommends assets for mission planning using Case Based Reasoning (CBR) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) artificial intelligence methodologies using live data from the Maritime Tactical Command and Control (MTC2) Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) web services.

Designed ABMA to be as extensible as possible and positioned the application to be capable of providing CBR as a service.

Coordinated with InScope International to interface with their GA service. The CBR cases seed the genetic algorithms to provide the system a “save point” with which future requests can continue to improve.

Developed a learning mechanism providing the end user the ability for feedback into the system. This feedback loop allows the system to learn preferred methods and generate new cases if necessary.

Expanding upon the CAPS project (below), enhanced the C2RPC SDK to be extensible as a generic Naval API allowing integration with C2RPC and MTC2 SOA services.

Expanding upon the RHAPSODy project (also below), enhanced the acetate layer like mapping service to include routing, mission, asset, and orange force overlays as well as a temporal awareness and mission reporting features.
